name: dsh-chat-wallpaper

one_liner.zh: 为 DSH Web 添加开场视频、聊天底图和可选大字横幅。
one_liner.en: Adds an intro video, chat wallpaper, and optional large text banner to DSH Web.

local: Loads videos and images from local paths and DSH profile folders.
Requires the DSH web client and host webServer service.
